Title: New Year's resolution for Detroit Pistons: 50-win season in reach

Summary: 
The Detroit Pistons have achieved a remarkable turnaround, entering 2026 with a 25-8 record—their best start since the 2007-08 season—and a 1½-game lead in the Eastern Conference and a 7½-game lead in the Central Division. This success followed a five-game winning streak that propelled them above .500 and secured their first playoff berth in six years. Cade Cunningham earned his first All-Star and All-NBA selections, and the team reached a six-game playoff series against the New York Knicks, ending a near-20-year drought without a postseason win. The team’s New Year’s resolution is to improve further, with the clear goal of advancing to the second round of the playoffs for the first time since 2008. The franchise is also aiming to reach 50 wins—its first since 2007-08—or even 60 wins, a feat achieved only three times in franchise history. Players have expressed a desire to become true contenders, and the front office, while cautious, acknowledges the team has surpassed all expectations. The Pistons now face a higher bar as they enter 2026.

Title: Detroit Pistons vs Cleveland Cavaliers Prediction and Betting Tips - Jan. 4 | 2025-26 NBA Season

Summary: 
The Detroit Pistons, with a 25-9 record and leading the Eastern Conference, face the Cleveland Cavaliers (20-16, No. 6 in the East) in a Central Division matchup on January 4, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. EST at Rocket Arena in Cleveland, Ohio. This is their second meeting of the 2025-26 NBA season, with the Cavaliers having previously defeated the Pistons 108-94 on October 27. The Pistons are currently on a six-win streak in their last 10 games and are without key player Jalen Duren due to a sprained ankle. The Cavaliers, despite injuries, are on a three-game winning streak, having defeated the San Antonio Spurs, Phoenix Suns, and Denver Nuggets. Sportskeeda provides betting tips: Donovan Mitchell is favored to go OVER 28.5 points (-106), Cade Cunningham to go OVER 27.5 points (-110), and Darius Garland to go OVER 17.5 points (-115). The game will be televised on FanDuel Sports Network Detroit and FanDuel Sports Network Ohio, and streamed on Peacock, fuboTV, and NBA League Pass.

Title: Central Division Odds for 2025-26 NBA Season (Cavaliers are runaway favorites)

Summary: 
The Cleveland Cavaliers are the overwhelming favorites to win the Central Division in the 2025-26 NBA season, with -350 odds at FanDuel Sportsbook and an implied probability of 77.8%. The team finished first in the division last season, boasting the league’s top-ranked offense, averaging 121.9 points per game, and returning a trio of All-Stars: Donovan Mitchell (24.0 PPG), Darius Garland, and De'Andre Hunter. Evan Mobley, the reigning Defensive Player of the Year, averaged a career-high 18.7 PPG, while Jarrett Allen remains a dominant rebounder and shot-blocker. The supporting cast includes Sam Merrill, Dean Wade, Larry Nance Jr., and Lonzo Ball, who could add depth if healthy after a two-year absence. In contrast, the Detroit Pistons, despite Cade Cunningham’s career-best season (26.1 PPG, 9.1 APG) and All-Star selection, lack the star power to challenge Cleveland. The Milwaukee Bucks, without Giannis Antetokounmpo’s former sidekicks Damian Lillard, Khris Middleton, and Brook Lopez, now rely on Myles Turner and an unproven Kyle Kuzma, making them a weak contender. The Indiana Pacers face a steep challenge after Tyrese Haliburton’s season-ending Achilles tear and the loss of key contributors like Myles Turner; though Pascal Siakam leads the offense and Aaron Nembhard and TJ McConnell provide backcourt depth, the team lacks a reliable center, with Isaiah Jackson and James Wiseman both sidelined by Achilles injuries. The Chicago Bulls are projected to finish last again, despite young talent in Coby White and Josh Giddey, due to defensive fragility and lack of depth and direction. The article concludes that the Cavaliers are the clear team to beat, while the rest of the division remains significantly behind.

Published date: October 13 2025, 14:00
